name: com.eglab.gameready.usd
displayName: GameReady USD Physics Importer and Exporter
description: Extends the Unity USD importer graph so UsdPhysics (mass, center of mass, inertia, colliders, physics materials, joints, joint drives) becomes Rigidbody, Collider, PhysicsMaterial and ConfigurableJoint components at import time, with exact asymmetric joint limits and GameReady semantic labels. Exports Unity scenes back to GameReady usda (UsdPhysics, meshes, UsdPreviewSurface materials, labels).
